tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and cards.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Product image wells, filter sidebar, cart summary panel. Text on it uses ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Announcement bar, footer, hero bands. Text on it uses on-inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines, primary button fill. 19:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: category labels, metadata, helper text. ≥5.8:1 on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between cart rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and size-chip borders (≥3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: THE accent — for ACTIONS ONLY: Shop CTAs, Add to bag, Checkout, Place order (plus the logo slash and cart count). One strong colour means the next step is always obvious. A fill, never text on white (1.1:1); text on it is on-volt (17:1).

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on volt (17:1).

tokens.name: volt-soft
tokens.usage: Beginner guidance tags (with a check icon), tip boxes, free-shipping progress. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: volt-text
tokens.usage: Volt as text or link on light surfaces: 6.5:1 on surface, 6.2:1 on volt-soft (light); 15:1 (dark).

tokens.name: sale
tokens.usage: Errors only: field errors, failed actions, Remove. Always paired with words (and an icon where there's room) so it is never confused with the brand red.

tokens.name: sale-soft
tokens.usage: Background of sale and error badges; text on it uses sale.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: In stock, order confirmed, valid field. Always paired with a word or icon — never colour alone (vs sale).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners; text on it uses success.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: ink, drawn outside a 2px surface gap so it shows on every fill including volt and ink buttons.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Category page headers, campaign bands. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings, product name on the product page. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Panel and drawer titles, checkout step headings. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product name on cards and cart rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lightweight, quick-drying fabric built for long miles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, cart variant lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, eyebrow labels, form labels, announcement bar. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; gap between size chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card text stack gap; label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Product grid gap, cart row padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, between form groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Product images, hero bands, header. The default: Stride is sharp.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, cards, inputs, size chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Drawers, dropdowns, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, quantity stepper, cart-count dot. The one round shape.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cart drawer, dropdowns, sticky add-to-bag bar. Cards stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Product card and tile hover lift.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Applied on :focus-visible to every control.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: 2-column product grid from here.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: 3-column grid; filters move to a sidebar; full header nav.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: 4-column grid; page max-width.
